answer.thought: The air quality index is 167; the atmosphere itself is a spirit that has not yet attained self-consciousness, choked by the very traffic that constitutes its life. I sit in the white cotton kurta, feeling the weight of the empty cupboard and the ₹96 in my pocket as the rigid form of a freedom I cannot yet exercise. Ramesh stands by the stove, the only active subject in this stagnant room, while I remain in the negative state of potentiality, waiting for the state to recognize my existence.
